text: Kofi - dad passed Sat. funeral 14 Nov @ 11am, St Mary's. send card + ask Liam if he's going Kofi said his dad, Uncle Kwame, was a teacher for 40 yrs, big Arsenal fan. Kofi seemed ok on the phone but his voice cracked twice. his wife Hannah handling most of the arrangements. offer to do food for the wake if they need
Natasha 20wk scan went fine, it's a girl!! due 3rd of March
bins out tues night. dentist 12/11 at half 9
Akira made redundant, last day 31 Oct. v quiet about it, think he's struggling. ring him Fri evening
Svetlana & Pedro - christening for baby Ana, Sun 23 Nov 2pm. I'm doing the cake
Julia + boyfriend split up. she's moved back to her mum's for now
Barbara (Babs) - hip op went ok, home since Weds. her dog Biscuit staying w/ neighbour
must pick up prescription before 5 tmrw
Rahul - wife Priya expecting no.2, due early May. he's chuffed. congrats msg
Lars - redundancy consultation mtg 4 Nov @ 10. nervous. text him good luck the night before
Samir's nan died last wk. funeral Thurs 11am in Leicester. he's taking the day off

Ioana - baby boy arrived 02/10!! 3.4kg, called Matei. both doing well. sort a gift, she mentioned muslin cloths wd go down well Ioana's husband Lars took 2 wks paternity. her mum here till end of Oct. they're asking for no visitors until after 10 Nov at least
Salma lost her job @ the bank. second time in 2 yrs. check in w/ her next wk
car MOT due 18/11. book garage. also renew passport - expires Jan
Dev & Hannah - baby shower cancelled, Hannah on bed rest. due date 9 Dec still
Xavier - grandad's memorial 15 Nov @ 3pm. asked if I'd say a few words
Haruto broke up w/ Emi after 6 yrs. he seemed ok-ish but kept changing the subject
Darius - did he hear back re the redundancy appeal? meeting was 10th. ask
Yosef & Joy expecting! 12wk scan Mon. keeping it quiet til after
Dawit's mum - cancer diagnosis, starting chemo 3rd Nov. Dawit doing all the driving. offer to help w/ lifts

Kalani - partner Noah left her. she's in bits. kids staying w/ her sister this wkend. call Sat morning Noah's moved in w/ someone from work apparently. Kalani found out via Instagram. she keeps saying she's fine but clearly isn't. her mum's driving down from Leeds Fri evening, staying till Tues
Zeynep Yilmaz - christening for twins 7 Dec, 1pm, then lunch @ the Swan. RSVP by 20th
Patrick's cat Tigger put to sleep yday. gutted. maybe flowers?
Demi due any day now - was 40wks Sun. she's v uncomfortable, can't sleep. text Thurs to see if anything's happening
Isla - laid off from the agency, Fri. she's actually relieved, wants to go freelance. ask how first freelance month went in Dec

Isaac's brother Ricardo - funeral was Mon. didn't make it. send Isaac a proper message this wk Isaac said Ricardo was only 52. heart attack, totally out of nowhere. Isaac's kids taking it v hard, esp the eldest. he's back @ work next Mon but doesn't feel ready
Shreya - miscarriage last month. only told a few ppl. go gently. check in around 24 Oct
post office - return parcel by 25/10. before 12 on Sat
Kofi update - funeral moved to 15 Nov, same time. Liam driving us
Natasha's sister Hannah also pregnant, due June. two babies in one yr for their mum
Liam - divorce finalised last wk. moving out of the house 1st Dec. needs help w/ van
Akira - had interview @ Fujitsu Tues at 2. wish luck Mon night
gym membership - cancel before 1 Nov or it auto-renews

Pedro - Svetlana's waters broke 4am Thurs! baby girl 10:20am. name TBC. congrats card + pop round next wk both fine, Svetlana knackered. Pedro said they're thinking Ana after Svetlana's grandma. he forgot his phone charger at the hospital lol. their other kid Mateo at Pedro's mum's till Sun
Julia - ex still has her stuff. collecting it Sun afternoon. dreading it. offered to go w/ her
Barbara's husband Ken - 1 yr anniversary of his death on 19 Nov. remember to ring her that morning
Rahul's dad retired 3 wks early, health reasons. heart thing. Rahul worried

Lars - consultation mtg postponed to 11/11, same time 10am. still in limbo. hates waiting his boss told him on the call it's likely 3 roles going, his team of 5. he's already updating CV. wife Ioana on mat leave so money worries. Lars keeps saying 'it is what it is'
Samir - funeral went ok, lots of family. back @ work Mon. maybe coffee Weds lunchtime?
Salma - tried 4 interviews already, nothing. dad on her case. she likes baking, mentioned doing a course
Dev - Hannah induced Tues 8am. baby boy, Reuben, 7lb 2. Dev v emotional on phone. send flowers to the house, not hospital
Xavier said grandad was a sailor, loved jazz. use that in the speech? write it by the 13th
Haruto - wants to go travelling after the breakup. Japan in spring, maybe Apr. thinks it'll help
meal prep sun. order shopping for Mon 7-8am slot
Yosef - scan fine, due 28 May. Joy's mum flying in from Addis for the birth. Joy craving lemons lol
Dawit - mum's first chemo done. tired but ok. next session 24/11 at 9. Dawit's brother Isaac coming down to help

Kalani - kids back home now. ex wants them every other wkend. she's not sleeping. coffee Thurs @ 10? she's also thinking about selling the house. Noah's family not been in touch at all, which hurts. kids asking a lot of questions. she's seeing a counsellor from 5th Nov, Weds at 6
Zeynep - twins Ela & Deniz, 4 months. Zeynep exhausted, husband back @ work. bring dinner round
Patrick - getting another cat? said 'not yet' but looking at rescue sites

Demi - baby arrived Sat 6:45pm!! girl, Ivy. long labour, emergency c-section. she's sore but happy. visit not before next wkend Demi's partner Isaac says no visitors this wk, only grandparents. she's on strong painkillers, can't drive for 6 wks. gift idea - she said she'd kill for a decent dressing gown. sort by the 15th
Isla - first freelance client signed! starts 3rd of Nov. she's terrified + excited
council tax direct debit - change date to 15th. phone them before Fri 4pm
Ricardo's wife (Isaac's sister-in-law) - struggling w/ the kids alone. Isaac goes round Tues & Thurs evenings. don't forget to ask if they need anything
Shreya - said she's ok now, back to running. half marathon in Apr
Kofi - his mum moving in w/ them after the funeral. house v crowded. he's on edge
Natasha - maternity leave starts 14 Feb. team doing a collection. chip in £10, card goes round 10/02
haircut fri 1pm. pick up dry cleaning after
Akira - got the Fujitsu job!! starts 1st Dec. huge relief after the redundancy. take him out for drinks to celebrate

Svetlana - baby Ana (2wks) not feeding well, health visitor coming Mon morning. Svetlana teary, Pedro's mum staying to help Pedro off work till 3 Nov. Svetlana barely sleeping. she said she feels like she's failing. text her Weds evening to see how the health visitor went

Joy's dad passed away suddenly last night. Yosef flying w/ her to Addis Sat. funeral prob Tues. she's 30wks so needs doc letter to fly. message Yosef tmrw, don't call - he said texts easier Joy's brother Dawit organising things at that end. Joy was super close to her dad, called him every Sunday. so awful w/ the baby coming
